# Pinned minimal engine closure

RULE-02 vendors 347 source/test files (304 runtime source/type files) at `53a79413c58678b1c50dde57e71de5c123132716`. [upstream.lock.json](upstream.lock.json) binds original Git blobs, SHA-256, local bytes, scope, licenses, exact tests and two patches. Original patched bytes and the Lorcana MIT license are in provenance; [LICENSE](LICENSE) retains the root notice. P001 replaces automatic matcher loading with unchanged explicit preload; P002 disables environment-driven private tracing. No card catalog, simulator UI or generator is imported.

`@lorcana/vendor-engine` is engine-scope. Its sole export is compiled `dist/kernel.js` and the project-owned narrow declaration. Only engine-lab may import that entry. Raw upstream sources/tests/types are not application exports. Build bundles mutative1.3.0, @logtape/logtape2.0.7 and seedrandom3.0.5 into JavaScript, retaining development invariant checks. Bun1.4.2 and @logtape/pretty2.0.7 are development/test-only. Production has no Bun/source-loader/Node-environment dependency. Upstream source is transpiled and tested; project interfaces pass strict checks without a complete upstream strict-type claim.

`createSyntheticKernel(seed,players)` owns a runtime using two synthetic character definitions and twelve instances per player. It exposes only status/submit, normalizes results, supplies explicit player authority and never exports raw state/resources/logs/RNG. It is consumed through the project Lab/server adapter, rather than a supported external game API. Disposal belongs to the wrappers. Full game state, secure replay and viewer projections remain later work.

Use [the engine runbook](../../docs/runbooks/engine.md) for integrity, reproduction and tests; [validation](../../docs/validation/rule-02.md) carries results/limits and [ADR0009](../../docs/adr/0009-pinned-engine-qualification.md) the decision. No official cards, rewarded/private games or current-rules compatibility are accepted. The dated RULE-01 inventory records set001–013/CR2.0.1 references; CR2.3/set14 dates cannot grant admission.
